name: Relevant passage in the top five
purpose: At least one relevant document is among the first five results for a query.
record: Cases passed over public and private query sets, with nDCG@10 and recall@10 in the details.
disadvantages: Short topic questions on one kind of corpus; a hit in the top five does not show the answer was used.

name: Needed file among the first three files a builder's cards show
purpose: A card builder is judged by whether its cards lead a fixed selector to the file a task needs, at a price in money and time a team would pay for a build.
record: Per builder, the balanced score (accuracy, cost and time; [balance.cards_from_files]). A case passes when the needed file is among the first three files of the view the fixed selector renders: the picked cards in rank order, each card's files in the builder's own order, as production renders them without a per-query reordering. In the details: the same within the first ten files, the needed file anywhere in the view, the median and largest view in files, cards built, the build's id, its model calls, tokens, cost and seconds (charged to the first scored case).
disadvantages: The cases ask about one Python repository, so a builder good at prose folders is not measured; the selector is keyword IDF, not production's hybrid, because the vector half needs an authorized embedding run; a grouped card wins only if its builder orders its files well, because the selector already ranks one-file cards per question, so this stage favours the per-file floor and only a stage where a model reads the rendered view can show what grouping adds; one build is spread over the cases of one run, while a real build serves many more turns, so the price a model builder pays here is an upper bound.
cascading_conditionals: idea [kind=idea | scale=esoi/idea-rating-scale.md | min-pass-rate=0.75 | when=a new builder is described: rate it on the five questions of the scale before it is built] > offline [sample=sample:10 | real=no | gate=competitive | when=the builders that call no model build cards for the pinned corpus and the fixed selector ranks a sample of the cases, as a screen before their full run] > one [sample=sample:1 | real=yes | gate=all-pass | when=llm_topic_cards builds cards for the pinned corpus on the fast tier with --fresh and the cards and the ranking of one case are read by hand] > whole [sample=full | gate=competitive | when=every builder, the broken baselines included, runs every case on the pinned corpus with --fresh in one session, the model-calling builders under the metric run policy of quest-ai-runner (esoi/metric-run-policy.md there), and all are compared on the balanced score]
